terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Runs the web UI (Vite, http://localhost:5173) and the API (Express, http://localhost:5174) together. Sources .env.local (written by the Vercel env pull in the start step) so the API process receives REALYTICA_*/BLOB_* vars; a clean no-op when the file is absent. The Vite dev server proxies /api to the API.
